hints.title: Optimal Substring Compression
hints.text: Examine substrings of increasing lengths and evaluate whether compressing repetitions or concatenating sub-encodings yields shorter text.

hints.title: String Doubling for Periodicity
hints.text: A string s contains repeated periods if (s + s).find(s, 1) is strictly less than len(s), indicating period length p = pos.

hints.title: 2D Interval Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Define dp[i][j] as shortest encoding of s[i..j]. Base case length < 5 cannot be compressed. For each span, compare candidate k[encoded_period] against splits dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] for all intermediate k.
